<section class="research-section">
  <p class="eyebrow">RESEARCH APPROACH</p><h2>Connecting methods without overstating their integration</h2>
  <div class="three-column"><div><h3>Economic analysis</h3><p>Econometrics, evolutionary game modeling, life cycle costing, and assessment of environmental externalities.</p></div><div><h3>Environmental systems</h3><p>LCA, greenhouse gas accounting, grazing scenarios, and soil-carbon model workflows.</p></div><div><h3>Spatial evidence</h3><p>Remote sensing, land-cover data, GIS-style overlays, and elevation-based analysis.</p></div></div>
